ground_truth_passage: Interpretability research has become very good at finding structure: probes recover latent variables from activations. Yet finding a representation does not imply the model uses it, and showing that an intervention changes output does not imply the representation has been released in a way that respects downstream task structure. We show that locating a representation does not guarantee that linear interventions can reliably release it into model behavior, a failure mode we term bounded linear release and silent gate inversion.
